thread:
alexa_finance: EvoTech reported an unexpected jump on INV-99001 after renewal; they claim platform fee doubled. Can someone check contract mapping?

mike_sales: They signed AMND-7710 but I see Schedule X was uploaded empty. Sales notes say "to be filled post-migration".

nina_custsuccess: Customer expects legacy 9% during 60-day onboarding. They got billed flat $18k instead of percent on $200k commit. billing-bot: Invoice INV-99001 lines: ["Commit: $200,000", "Platform fee: $36,000", "Support: $6,500"], total_due: $242,500.

alexa_finance: If legacy 9% applies, expected platform fee = $18,000. That suggests a $18k overcharge.

lee_legal: I pulled AMND-7710: amendment executed but Schedule X page is unsigned. Unsigned schedule = non-binding. Default to Master SOW.

mike_sales: Customer says they authorized flat fee verbally but haven't signed. They'll accept revert if we issue a credit and then sign.

alexa_finance: Action: place INV-99001 on hold, create provisional credit CM-5500 for $18,000, route for director approval (> $10k), request written acceptance from customer.

billing-bot: CM-5500 provisional created for $18,000. Collection status set to On Hold - Billing Dispute.

nina_custsuccess: I told EvoTech we placed the invoice on hold and will issue corrected invoice once legal confirms. They confirmed they'll sign the schedule.

lee_legal: Confirmed unsigned schedule not enforceable. Approve credit routing; require signed Schedule X before next billing.

alexa_finance: CM-5500 approved by director. Credit posted; invoice corrected to INV-99001-R1. Marking dispute resolved. Sales to upload signed Schedule X.

mike_sales: Uploading signed schedule after customer signs; will notify finance. EvoTech acknowledged and closed on their side.

alexa_finance: Closing thread. Recorded actions: CM-5500, INV-99001-R1, note in AMND-7710 folder.
